C1510.title: XR/VR Privacy and Security Research in Immersive Environments
C1510.summary: A 2024 XR privacy and security survey explains that AR/VR devices continuously collect sensitive head and hand motion, eye-tracking, spatial-map, audio-video, and environmental-context data. These signals can reveal identity, biometrics, location, and behavioral patterns, while sensor fusion, spatial anchors, and third-party app permissions amplify privacy exposure and data-abuse risks in immersive environments.
